assessment.scope: Part VI closing chapter B28 (content/docs/book/product-footprint-rules-and-practice.mdx), covering 3 new locally SHA-256-verified official open-access PDFs (GHG Protocol Product Standard 2011 148 pp.; Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 117 pp.; Regulation (EU) 2024/1781 ESPR 89 pp.), 9 1-to-1 single-artifact ev-pfr151-*/psg-pfr151-* pairs, 22 BigInt rational numericFacts, 8 new cl-pfr151-* claims, 22 normalized non-case ev-kb44-* locators, 1 explicit paywalled-standard research gap, and 2 comparison tables (Table 1 six columns, Table 2 five columns) against predecessor commit 3c6844be00ad3d39be3199ffbb257324a5daab79.
assessment.comparison: Systematically compares non-binding EU PEF Recommendation (EU) 2021/2279 & Dairy PEFCR, single-issue GHG Protocol Product Standard (2011), binding directly-applicable EU Batteries Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 (Arts. 7, 17, 96 & Annexes II, VIII), and binding cross-product EU ESPR (EU) 2024/1781 (Arts. 1-13, 79-80 & Annex I) across legal force, impact scope, functional unit vs reference flow, use-phase inclusion/exclusion, non-attributable processes, biogenic/direct-LUC/offset rules, assurance vs Notified Body Modules D1/G, product-vs-corporate Scope 3 boundaries, comparative assertion gates, and explicit paywalled-standard boundaries (ISO 14067:2018, ISO 14025:2006, EN 15804+A2, GB/T 24067-2024).
assessment.values: Verifies all 22 exact BigInt rational numericFacts across the 3 official primary PDFs (117/89/148 pages, >2 kWh, 12/18 months, 3-year review, 1 kWh / 1 kWmin, 4 stages, 5 core battery parts, 2 notified-body modules, 0 occurrences of "declared unit", 3 exclusion conditions, 6 Kyoto GHGs, 100-year GWP/horizon, 20-year direct LUC, 2 assurance levels, 1 as-is use in Table A.2 p. 116, 2025/2026 ESPR statutory dates).
assessment.limits: Paywalled full texts of ISO 14067:2018, ISO 14025:2006, EN 15804+A2, and GB/T 24067-2024 are explicitly recorded as open boundaries without fabricated clause numbers; B27 targeted comparative update, Part VI whole-part continuous reread, Parts VII-VIII, and all 8 global Programme #9 criteria remain open.
assessment.conservation: Conserves 100% of all 34 original cl-rule-* claims, all 4 pinned B28 headings, all 5 case-bound dairy-rules-v1.json locators, all 1,026 non-B28 claims, and all 40 case files byte-for-byte.
assessment.review: Two-round independent primary-source and numeric entailment audit verified SHA-256 digests, PDF page indices, modal precision, Table A.2 / Annex VIII L 191/96-101 citations, 1-to-1 bindings, and BigInt arithmetic, concluding unconditional PASS (0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 0 MINOR).
